en.title: Global Macro — France turns the global bond shock into a euro-area fragmentation test
en.deck: French sovereign and bank risk premia are widening faster than the common euro-area rate shock, while AI-linked borrowers still access large pools of capital at a higher marginal price.
en.regime: Selective fragmentation under expensive capital: common long-rate pressure is increasingly differentiated by fiscal credibility and sector-specific access to credit.
en.key_risk: France-specific sovereign and bank risk premia could tighten domestic financing faster than the ECB common stance implies.

pt-BR.title: Global Macro — França e a fragmentação do custo de capital
pt-BR.deck: O prêmio de risco francês aumenta dentro da zona do euro enquanto emissores ligados à IA ainda acessam grandes volumes de capital a um custo marginal maior.
pt-BR.regime: Fragmentação seletiva sob capital caro: a pressão dos juros longos é diferenciada por credibilidade fiscal e acesso setorial ao crédito.
pt-BR.key_risk: Prêmios soberanos e bancários franceses podem apertar o financiamento doméstico mais rapidamente do que a política comum do BCE sugere.

novelty_gate.dominant_delta: France-specific sovereign risk became the new marginal mechanism: the 10-year France-Germany spread exceeded 110 bp and French five-year CDS reached about 52 bp while the euro weakened despite higher regional yields.
novelty_gate.repetition_control: High U.S. and Japanese yields, AI capex and Gulf energy risk are background or transmission channels rather than the lead.
